display.summary: Outbound calls go through the Composer agent, so a generated stack can keep web and celery off the internet; weather is the first feature on it.
highlights: The Composer agent makes outbound calls for the project through a small, typed channel (needs Composer 1.6.0b1 or newer), with API keys sealed so only the agent can read them.
Weather works on a generated stack with no change to compose.yml, and the settings page says which fix applies when a search fails.
Projects declare their own outbound calls in relay/operations.json and approve them with `composer relay approve`; nothing else in the project can reach the internet.
A project with no Celery is now reported as offline on the Options page instead of the row being hidden.
